title: quorum-cascade dynamics/timing deep-dive — how the collective cascade unfolds over time (onset latency vs density · propagation finite-speed · monotone temporal unfolding) on the RFC 036 phi_spatial CA substrate (H_262 depth)
honest_tier: 🟢 SUPPORTED-NUMERICAL (phi_spatial proxy + deterministic CA cascade timing sweep; NOT 🔵 formal IIT 4.0)
lineage: H_262 quorum-sensing (SUPPORTED_FULL, global quorum-gate) → H_274 seed-dependence (FALSIFIED, residual = dynamical cascade timing) → H_276 opens the timing axis directly
substrate: 1D periodic CA ring (N=16); per-cell hysteretic latch (up=1.0 dn=0.4, H_262 verbatim) driven by a LOCAL-quorum-gated cooperative boost (boost=coupling when local active-fraction in radius-1 neighbourhood exceeds q_thr=0.3); seed-phased deterministic init, ZERO RNG

F1_ONSET_DENSITY.metric: onset latency monotone non-increasing in seed density AND >=1 density onsets

F2_PROPAGATION.metric: single-seed front monotone non-decreasing, grows >=1, max step <= front_cap (finite speed)

F3_MONOTONE.metric: Q(t) non-decreasing for all t after cascade trigger (one-way temporal ratchet)

F5_BOUNDS.metric: all Q in [0,1], latency in [-1,max_steps), front in [0,N/2]

verdict_rule: SUPPORTED_FULL iff C1 AND C2 AND C3 AND F4; SUPPORTED iff C1 AND C3; PARTIAL iff C1 only; FALSIFIED iff NOT C1
honest_limits: L1: phi_spatial = 🟢 NUMERICAL spatial-slice replica of phi_rs, NOT full IIT 4.0 (RFC 036 §FFI shim named blocker). The Φ trajectory locates integrated information but is a proxy, carried verbatim from the LIFE-lane lib/phi_helper.hexa.

L2: timing is measured on a SINGLE calibration (base=0.012, coupling=0.2, q_thr=0.3, radius=1). Onset-latency ordering and front speed are calibration-dependent: a higher base would let cells reach up_thr without the boost (no quorum-gate), and a larger radius would shrink the front-propagation regime toward an instantaneous global flip.

L3: the CA cascade is a LOCAL-quorum SPATIAL generalization of H_262's GLOBAL quorum (each cell sees its radius-1 neighbourhood, not the whole pool). This is the design choice that MAKES propagation finite-speed (C2) meaningful; it is a deliberate substrate extension, not a byte-equal carry of H_262's global gate.

L4: onset latency is measured at the majority crossing Q>=0.5 and the density sweep is COARSE (4 contiguous block sizes 2/4/6/8 of N=16). A finer density grid could reveal a non-monotone micro-structure between adjacent densities that the coarse grid averages over; the monotone claim is at this grid resolution.

L5: front radius is the ring-distance of the FARTHEST active cell from the seed centre; it measures the OUTER envelope of propagation, not a filled-front guarantee (interior cells may lag). C2 finite-speed is an envelope-speed claim. A filled-front (every interior cell active behind the front) claim would need a per-cell ignition-time map.

L6: monotone-unfolding (C3) is checked AFTER the cascade trigger (Q first exceeds q_thr); the pre-trigger transient may be non-monotone (the seed block + leak can dip before the boost engages). C3 is a post-trigger ratchet claim, not a global-monotone claim over all t.

L7: determinism is integer-exact (NO RNG, seed-phased init), so F4 is byte-equal BY CONSTRUCTION on this substrate — a stronger guarantee than H_262/H_274's cross-process gaussian-stream determinism, but it tests determinism of THIS substrate only, not the gaussian-stream path those cycles relied on.
